title: E5: Third Independent Human MTJ Cohort Replication

protocol.hypothesis: The frozen 1,176-gene human myonuclear MTJ transcriptional program maintains directional concordance (> 60%) in an independent adult human skeletal muscle MTJ-vs-mature contrast.

panel_definition.source: MTJCore Frozen Panel (Stage 5 derived from E-MTAB-12529)
panel_definition.marker_guard: Exclusion of top 6 annotation markers to prevent circular clustering bias

statistical_specification.gene_inclusion_criterion: Count >= 10 in >= 2 donors in held-out dataset
statistical_specification.missing_marker_handling: Excluded from test; if coverage < 50%, declare INCONCLUSIVE
statistical_specification.donor_independence_strategy: Donor-paired generalized linear model (edgeR QLF / DESeq2)
statistical_specification.null_distribution: Correlation-preserving gene-set permutation (accounting for inter-gene covariance)
statistical_specification.primary_endpoint: Concordant direction fraction S_rep = N_concordant / N_tested

decision_rules.REPLICATED: S_rep >= 0.60 AND p_null < 0.05 with >= 3 independent donors
decision_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: Gene panel coverage < 50% or donor N < 3
decision_rules.DATA_BLOCKED: Absence of fully independent public human MTJ transcriptomic dataset

E-MTAB-12529.name: Karlsen et al. (2023) — ArrayExpress
E-MTAB-12529.sample_type: Human adult semitendinosus MTJ vs belly snRNA-seq
E-MTAB-12529.reason: Discovery cohort. Donor 1 provided 51.2% of myonuclei. Reusing discovery data as independent validation is circular.

E-MTAB-15400.name: Møbjerg et al. (2025) — ArrayExpress
E-MTAB-15400.sample_type: Human adult vastus lateralis MTJ biopsies snRNA-seq
E-MTAB-15400.reason: Already evaluated in Stage 6. Result was 0.5818 concordant fraction (< 0.60 threshold). Re-labeling it as a new test is prohibited.

E-MTAB-12530.name: Karlsen et al. (2023) 10x Visium — ArrayExpress
E-MTAB-12530.reason: Uses biopsy sections from the exact same 3 donors as E-MTAB-12529 (Copenhagen). Violates donor biological independence.

HRA002803.name: Zhao et al. (2022) — GSA-Human (NGDC China)
HRA002803.reason: Controlled-access repository requiring Data Access Committee (DAC) application and institutional ethics transfer; not accessible via open download.

Jakobsen_2021.name: Jakobsen et al. (2021) — AJP-Cell Physiol
Jakobsen_2021.sample_type: Horse and human MTJ bulk RNA-seq
Jakobsen_2021.reason: Same laboratory (Mackey/Kjær, Copenhagen). Raw count matrices were not deposited under a public open repository accession number.

rationale: No qualified third independent human adult MTJ transcriptomic dataset exists in open repositories. E-MTAB-12529 is discovery; E-MTAB-15400 failed Stage 6 (0.5818 < 0.60); E-MTAB-12530 has identical donors; HRA002803 is controlled-access. Experiment E5 is DATA_BLOCKED.

Stage_6.confounder: Biological sex confounded with training condition

biological_boundaries: RNA direction replication does NOT equal mechanical force transmission.
Transcriptional presence of COL22A1/ABI3BP does NOT prove tendon tensile strength.
No evidence that MTJ myonuclear program can be artificially induced without pathological fibrosis.
